datePolicy: Original November 6, 2026 Asia/Singapore source access dates retained; underlying UTC receipts were November 5. Copy editing is not an external refresh, price check or availability check.

Hotel member advance-purchase lead-ins cover unspecified dates/occupancy over the next 30 days, not February family rooms; breakfast and taxes were not established.
Park prices used the November 6 default date. Junior ticket category depends on height; ride restrictions are separate. February hours, maintenance and Children's Museum hours are unconfirmed.
Ramadan start is projected, not final. Historical Salik Ramadan bands are not 2027 schedules. Recheck dining, attraction hours, toll schedules and route-specific gates.
AD Mobility AED 25 fare conflicts with the observed RTA AED 30 planner result; budget uses the higher amount. Bus transfers, fuel, tolls, food, travel times and small buffer are estimates.
No crowd guarantee, general resident discount or usable February Tasty Ticket offer established; souvenirs, Quick Pass, rentals and hotel buffets excluded.
editingContract: Reader-first English-only draft with semantic headline figures, tables and exact source registry. No Chinese page or bilingual parity claim. Local package only; no Review, stars or public attachment promises.
